members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1726 stores keepAliveTimer directly in the StreamMapping interface, so the timer's lifecycle is owned by the same cleanup/cancel path that manages the rest of the stream state — avoiding potential timer leaks if the cancel branch is not reached. It also exposes keepAliveInterval as a user-configurable transport option (changeset tagged minor) and has broader coverage (211 additions, 19 deletions vs 45 additions). PR #2124's local-variable approach with a clearKeepAlive closure is a narrower patch-level fix that duplicates the same interval pattern without integrating into the existing stream-management architecture.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1996 introduces a proper RFC 7231-compliant `acceptsMediaType()` helper that handles wildcards (`*/*`, `application/*`), case-insensitive matching, and explicit rejection via `q=0`. PR #2046 uses a plain `String.includes()` check that misses those edge cases (e.g. `Accept: application/*` would not match, and `Accept: application/json;q=0` would incorrectly pass). The more thorough parser in #1996 is less likely to need follow-up fixes.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2215 makes the same normalization fix as #2214 in both call sites, but also corrects a latent bug introduced by the change: after normalizing '/' to '', the shouldAttemptFallback guard (pathname === '/') never matches the now-empty string, causing root-level discovery URLs to proceed to a redundant fallback. #2215 fixes that guard to (pathname === '') and extracts the logic into a reusable normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper. PR #2214 leaves shouldAttemptFallback with a stale comparison.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Trailing slashes on OAuth discovery paths produce malformed double-slash URLs (e.g. /foo//.well-known/…). Both PRs replace the single-slash strip (endsWith('/') + slice(0,-1)) with replace(/\/+$/, '') in buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls.
